title: Best app for Planning my days
body: It’s simple, well designed, and genuinely helps me stay focused on my goals and habits. Setting up daily routines is straightforward and makes it clear what I should prioritize. The reminders are helpful without being intrusive, which makes staying consistent feel natural. I also appreciate how flexible it is while still keeping me on track.I just love it.
author: Muddassara S

title: Excellent Self-Improvement App
body: This is an excellent app for anyone looking to improve themselves and build better habits. The interface is clean, user-friendly, and easy to navigate. It offers useful features that help me stay motivated, organized, and focused on my personal goals. I’ve had a great experience using it and would definitely recommend it to anyone interested in personal growth. Keep up the great work!

title: Scam?
body: I watched a very long marketing video on Facebook where at the beginning you state you will give the app for free. Strong use of manipulation techniques. At the end you charge $18 for a life time subscription. Oscar left an explicit review here about this and you have not responded. I thought your $18 offer was to good to be true and certainly looks like this is just a marketing scam. Strange way to operate if you want to be taken seriously. Still no AI review in my email or any automated contact from you after filling in the form. Until you show otherwise, you are untrustworthy and people need to be made aware. Thank you
author: WhenWillTheyLearn

title: Scam
body: Your marketing disgusts me I paid 18 dollars through an ad promising me a lifetime subscription but didn’t get anything. You say you’re different but you’re just pathetic, I’m glad I paid for your next cheeseburger you f ing dumpster

title: Unstable but motivating
body: Great app I have have been using for quite some time. The biggest downside is that the habits and checkboxes jumps around. Some times they are counted inside the app but the ui shows me that I haven’t done the habit. Very frustrating. Will be looking for other apps if this is not fixed.
